summary: @marchthiessen "No" not "leverage" is the word for Democrats and the wall. Heck go Boehner, "Hell no. " the wall would be symbolic of the racism that propelled Trump to White House. Exact opposite of the Statue of Liberrty. We can not normalize hate.

body_html:
@marchthiessen "No" not "leverage" is the word for Democrats and the wall. Heck go Boehner, "Hell no. " the wall would be symbolic of the racism that propelled Trump to White House.

Exact opposite of the Statue of Liberrty.
